title: Fast LLM-Ready Markdown & Sitemap Crawler Input

startUrls.title: Target URLs or Sitemap URLs
startUrls.description: Direct page URLs (e.g. https://danlopes18-ctrl.github.io/) or sitemap URLs (e.g. https://danlopes18-ctrl.github.io/sitemap.xml).

discoverSitemap.title: Auto-Discover /sitemap.xml
discoverSitemap.description: When enabled, if a domain root URL is provided, also probe /sitemap.xml to crawl subpages up to maxPages.

maxPages.title: Max Pages to Extract
maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to extract per run (1-500).

includePattern.title: URL Include Regex (optional)
includePattern.description: Only extract URLs matching this regular expression (e.g. /docs/|/blog/).

excludePattern.title: URL Exclude Regex (optional)
excludePattern.description: Skip URLs matching this regular expression (e.g. /login|/pricing).

maxCharsPerPage.title: Max Markdown Characters Per Page
maxCharsPerPage.description: Trim page markdown above this character limit to keep LLM context windows lean (1000-200000).
